## Unblinding

Compound: **MG-132** (PubChem CID [462382](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/462382))

Identity check: name and BBBC021 structure agree

ChEMBL mechanisms: no curated mechanism in ChEMBL

## Verdict (computed by code)

Incorrect: agent said **Microtubule stabilizers**, BBBC021 annotates **Protein degradation**.

## Reflection

I concluded Microtubule stabilizers (p=0.88) on the 3uM well with tub_glcm_contrast z=+151.7, tub_mean z=+54.7 and rounded morphology plus 7/10 stabilizer neighbours in e7. Unblinded truth was MG-132, a proteasome inhibitor in the Protein degradation class (PMID 21499287, PMID 21203833, PMID 18435911), so the call was wrong.

I was misled by overweighting a single informative well with only 39 cells measured in e5 and the microscopist label Microtubule stabilizers in e6, while discounting the contradictory high-dose atlas in e4 with Microtubule destabilizers 4/10 and zero stabilizers and the combined-well atlas in e14 with Epithelial 3/10, Protein synthesis 3/10 and Microtubule destabilizers 2/10. Acquiring only 2 wells over 2 doses left all dose_response checks in e10-e13 uninterpretable and left no budget for a replicate, exactly the reproducibility failure flagged in review.

What was right was the toxicity signal: lower density in both describe_phenotype calls and severe cell loss to 39 cells at 3uM were consistent with proteasome-inhibitor cytotoxicity/proliferation loss rather than a clean taxane-like profile. Proteasome inhibition can produce a secondary tubulin-bright rounded mitotic-arrest mimic that the atlas matched to stabilizers, which I did not control for without a ubiquitin/proteasome activity readout.

What was right:
- Noted cytotoxicity cues at both doses: lower density vs DMSO and only 39 cells at 3uM in e5, consistent with proteasome-inhibitor lethality
- High-dose acquire e2 and atlas e4 correctly did not support stabilizers, warning that the phenotype was dose-dependent/toxic
- Combined-well atlas e14 with no stabilizer neighbours correctly warned that the 3uM-only 7/10 stabilizer match was not robust

What was wrong or missed:
- Submitted Microtubule stabilizers at 0.88 on one n=39 well e5-e7, overweighting extreme tubulin z-scores and 7/10 atlas neighbours
- Discounted contradictory e4 high-dose destabilizer/Epithelial match and e14 combined Epithelial/Protein synthesis/destabilizer match
- Acquisition plan used only 2 wells over 2 doses, so dose_response e10-e13 failed and no replicate could verify the tubulin-bright rounding signature
- Did not retain/test Protein degradation despite 1/10 Protein degradation neighbour in e7 and did not consider secondary mitotic arrest from proteasome inhibition

Proposed next experiment: Proteasome-Glo chymotrypsin-like activity plus anti-ubiquitin immunofluorescence / western blot dose-response for MG-132 vs bortezomib and docetaxel controls, paired with an in vitro tubulin polymerization assay to test direct stabilization.
